 Dermot Mulroney Says ‘The Family Stone’ Sequel Honors Diane Keaton’s Memory
 Tuesday, 17 November 2026, 22:54 
 Photo source: Variety 
 The original cast is reuniting for a sequel to the 2005 holiday film, with Mulroney saying Keaton’s memory is honored throughout the movie. 
 More than two decades after the original film, the Stone family is coming together again in a sequel that pays tribute to Diane Keaton.
 This is reported by Variety .
 Dermot Mulroney, who played Everett Stone in the 2005 holiday film, returns with original cast members Sarah Jessica Parker and Rachel McAdams. Despite their increasingly busy schedules, the actors agreed to reprise their roles in honor of Keaton, who played family matriarch Sybil, Mulroney told Variety.
 Diane’s memory is honored in everything. I would suggest that it has a different quality than just your garden variety sequel. Maybe it’s just that it’s a family returning together that gives it resonance. But there’s something magical about this movie. 
 - Dermot Mulroney
 Mulroney spoke at the premiere of Season 2 of “The Hunting Wives.”
 Advertisement 
 Titled “The Families Stones,” the sequel follows the family 20 years after their mother’s death. When they reunite for Christmas, their father surprises them by bringing home the woman he has since fallen in love with.
 Photos of Mulroney on set with Parker and McAdams went viral in October, generating buzz among fans of the original. Mulroney said the response amazed him and his co-stars.
 It really affirmed for us how beloved that film is, as if we needed to be told again. It ripened on the vine and grew over these 21 years, and we are, right now, in the process of a very magical experience. We’re riding high, just combining all of these loved ones playing loved ones. It’s remarkable. 
 - Dermot Mulroney
 Jean Smart joins the sequel. Returning cast members also include Claire Danes as Julie Morton, Craig T. Nelson as Kelly Stone, Luke Wilson as Ben Stone, Tyrone Giordano as Thad Stone, Elizabeth Reaser as Susannah Stone, Paul Schneider as Brad Stevenson and Brian White as Patrick Thomas.
 Mulroney was also promoting Season 2 of “The Hunting Wives,” in which he plays politician Jed Banks. The first season was based on May Cobb’s novel of the same name; Season 2 has no source material and was developed from the imaginations of creator, writer and showrunner Rebecca Perry Cutter and Cobb.
 They took Season 1 and went further somehow. We jumped off from that book that May Cobb wrote and made up a bunch of shit you won’t believe, to be quite honest. 
 - Dermot Mulroney
 Recalling his first time reading the Season 2 script, Mulroney said:
 Everything I think might happen doesn’t and whatever they come up with is 10 times better than anything I thought. 
 - Dermot Mulroney
 More interesting materials: 
 Diane Keaton's iconic role in The Family Stone remains a beloved holiday classic as the film marks its 20th anniversary, honoring her legacy after her recent passing.
